decisions.reason: Superyacht crew recruitment uses the firm's existing crewing network at low cost and its niche demand is still uncertain, so the cheap option stays open.
The Smart Academy is growing its partner network quickly and builds on the training centres, so early results support further commitment.
FuelEU Maritime monitoring is a regulatory necessity for clients, and the firm submitted every plan before the deadline, so its value is largely confirmed.
The dashboard is integrated into the PAL software and costs little to maintain, and its value grows as FuelEU compliance starts in 2025.
The cost simulator is a low-cost add-on to PAL whose value will become clearer as FuelEU penalties and pooling take effect, so the option is worth holding.
